usage: run_asv_eer_eval.py [-h] [--dataset {vctk,librispeech}]
                           --session_pool_csv SESSION_POOL_CSV --method_specs
                           METHOD_SPECS
                           [--speaker_encoder_name SPEAKER_ENCODER_NAME]
                           [--speaker_checkpoint_dir SPEAKER_CHECKPOINT_DIR]
                           [--speaker_checkpoint_dir_xvector SPEAKER_CHECKPOINT_DIR_XVECTOR]
                           [--telephony_config TELEPHONY_CONFIG]
                           [--group_key {session_id,utter_id}]
                           [--selection_source {clean,defended,tele_defended}]
                           [--k K]
                           [--impostors_per_target IMPOSTORS_PER_TARGET]
                           [--seed SEED] --output_csv OUTPUT_CSV
                           [--output_margin_csv OUTPUT_MARGIN_CSV]

Compute ASV EER for baseline/v0p1_B on v3 targeted tele-defended setting.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dataset {vctk,librispeech}
  --session_pool_csv SESSION_POOL_CSV
  --method_specs METHOD_SPECS
                        Comma-separated name:checkpoint, use empty checkpoint
                        for baseline, e.g. baseline:,v0p1_B:/abs/path.pt
  --speaker_encoder_name SPEAKER_ENCODER_NAME
  --speaker_checkpoint_dir SPEAKER_CHECKPOINT_DIR
  --speaker_checkpoint_dir_xvector SPEAKER_CHECKPOINT_DIR_XVECTOR
  --telephony_config TELEPHONY_CONFIG
  --group_key {session_id,utter_id}
  --selection_source {clean,defended,tele_defended}
  --k K
  --impostors_per_target IMPOSTORS_PER_TARGET
  --seed SEED
  --output_csv OUTPUT_CSV
  --output_margin_csv OUTPUT_MARGIN_CSV
